He found me when I was just a street rat playing on empty cans. He made me the person I am today. I owe him my ''life'', droid.''"
"''And I owe Umpass mine, several times over.|Umpass-stay and Ak-rev|}} '''Umpass-stay''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Klatooinian]] who worked as a [[drum]]mer and bodyguard for the [[Max Rebo Band]] at the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Four [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]], he and the rest of the band performed the song ''[[Jedi Rocks]]'' for Jabba, who demanded they repeat the song but then dropped the [[Slavery|enslaved]] [[Oola]] into his [[rancor]] pit when she refused his advances during the performance. The band stopped playing as the rancor [[Death|devored]] the slave, and then witnessed the arrival of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] as a prisoner. ==Biography== {{Quote|So anything—''anything''—that the chief has to say to me, it can be said in front of Ak-rev. Clear?''"
"''Right-oh! It's your funeral. Anyway, the message is simple…''kill Jabba!''|Umpass-stay and a DRK-1 probe droid|}} Umpass-stay was a [[Klatooinian]] [[mercenary]] from the [[planet]] [[Klatooine]] who was [[Slavery|enslaved]] by the [[Desilijic]] [[Kajidic]] and essentially forced to work as both bodyguard and [[Musician|drummer]] for the [[Max Rebo Band]], the house band of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], with the Klatooinian also serving as a bodyguard for Jabba himself.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' In [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]]. he and the [[Weequay]] drummer [[Ak-rev]] performed a duet together on an enormous [[drum]] that required two drummers during a performance by the band in the throne room of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the planet [[Tatooine]].{{Film|VI}} The band initially played a relatively slow piece as [[Oola]] and [[Yarna d'al' Gargan]], a pair of [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancers, performed in front of Jabba. When the song finished, Jabba demanded that Oola repeat her performance, but thinking that the Hutt had been speaking to the band, the singer [[Joh Yowza]] counted them down into another song.[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] The [[Growdi Harmonique]] player [[Rappertunie]] began playing the wrong song, but after Yowza shouted at him, the whole band began playing "[[Jedi Rocks]]."{{SW|url=news/music-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-the-modal-nodes-vs-the-max-rebo-band|text=Music in the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band|int=Music in the Star Wars Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band}} Ak-rev and Umpass-stay's drumming was then brought to a stop when Jabba dropped Oola through a trapdoor after she refused his advances. Musical performance forgotten, Jabba's court rushed forward to instead watch as Oola was [[Death|devoured]] alive by the Hutt's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]], in a pit below. [[File:Umpass-stay_btm.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Umpass-stay was a drummer for the Max Rebo Band.]] After the excitement surronding Oola's demise died down, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]—disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]]—entered the throne room with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] as her [[prisoner]]. After she bargained with Jabba over the [[bounty]] on the Wookiee's head, the band began playing again as Chewbacca was taken away to the Hutt's [[prison]]s. The drum that Umpass-stay and Ak-rev were playing had been removed from the throne room later that [[Local day|night]] when Organa freed the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] from the [[carbonite]] he had been frozen in on one of the room's walls. The next [[Standard day|day]], Jabba and much of his court traveled to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] to execute Solo, Chewbacca, and the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] there; however, the prisoners fought back and Jabba was killed. After Jabba's death, Umpass-stay and Ak-rev both fled from the palace. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Thst turnaround in ''Ballad of Bosovir'' keeps eating you alive, ''Ak-rev!''''"
"''Only 'cus you keep dragging the bridge.''"
"''Wrong! The bridge is meant to drag—it's bum bam badim ''bap!'' Ask Max!|Umpass-stay and Ak-rev|}} Umpass-stay was one of the more unusual Klatooinians in Jabba's Palace. A beefy individual,{{StoryCite|story=Fancy Man|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}} he had [[Color|brown]] skin and dark [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Umpass-stay wore brown and gray chest [[armor]] with red cloth straps over a black [[Clothing|shirt]] with white sleeves. The drummer also wore brown pants, brown [[boot]]s, a tan [[belt]], and a tan head wrap. He used a single large drumstick while playing the drum. ==Behind the scenes== Umpass-stay first appeared in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] in [[1997]]. He was first named in the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]] which was released in [[1998]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Umpass-stay}} *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} {{C|Introduced in [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']]}} *{{StoryCite|story=Fancy Man|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} *[[Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo 1|''Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo'' 1]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|19|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' {{1stID|Umpass-stay}} *{{ForceAttax|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Umpass-stay|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287797/2016-Topps-Force-Attax-Star-Wars-The-Force-Awakens-69-Umpass-Stay}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Lando Calrissian and Other Characters From the Galaxy}} *{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-marvel|text=SWCE 2023: Marvel Reveals ''Star Wars: Dark Droids'' Horror Event and More}} {{Po}} *{{InsiderCite|220|Launchpad}} *{{InsiderCite|224|Hit it, Max!}} *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Umpass-stay |ja=アンパス＝ステイ |pl=Umpass-stay }} [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Desilijic servants]] [[Category:Enslaved individuals]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Klatooinians]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Max Rebo Band members]] [[Category:Mercenaries]]
